alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not keep only first-N events, discard the tail, auto-restart an interrupted CPI or label a partial trace COMPLETE.
applicability: FPGA overflow/saturation telemetry and host-side evidence capture.
assessed_root_cause: Telemetry correctness is part of evidence integrity; a truncated or incomplete trace cannot support a clean acceptance disposition.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Use append-only event records, stable IDs, full values and location fields; verify byte count, order, hash and complete readback; fail closed on interruption or mismatch.
generalizable_lesson: Telemetry must be treated as a data path with its own completeness, ordering and durability assertions.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: A short event summary or a successful write call could be treated as proof that every event was captured.
non_applicability: Does not establish that hardware telemetry FIFO sizing or UART throughput is adequate; that requires RTL and interface verification.
observable_consequence: C06 added stable event identities, complete pre-narrow integers, stage/location/component, signedness, cumulative counts, sticky flags, ordering, fsync/readback/hash checks and incomplete-trace preservation; final CPI traces were read back.
observed_problem: Overflow and input-saturation events can be lost if telemetry stores only a bounded preview, silently truncates or reports success before durable readback.
repeatable_validation: Run logger unit tests, diagnostic stress vector and interrupted-run smoke; for actual CPI require per-CPI trace manifests and readback.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Preserve C02 event fields and full pre-narrow integer; no hidden truncation or automatic CPI retry.
title: Full Trace is an acceptance artifact: ordered, complete, read-back verified and fail-closed
